name: Zhatan the Black
canonNotes: Commander of the Tower of Zharr, remarkable for his brutality even among the cruel slave-masters of the Plain of Zharrduk.
A warlord of the Chaos Dwarfs' military, who rules through fear.
voiceNotes: Harsh, brutal and commanding; speaks of chains, discipline and war.
Contempt for weakness; everything is a resource.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
